hooks.command: sh -c 'f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/py/launch.sh"; [ -r "$f" ] && exec sh "$f" hook brief; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$d" in /*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; h="${HOME%/}"; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "$h" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do [ -f "$d/.factory/factory.toml" ] && { printf "{\"continue\":true,\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"SessionStart\",\"additionalContext\":\"vsdd-factory: the plugin files are missing, so the factory gates are blocking. Reinstall the plugin.\"},\"systemMessage\":\"vsdd-factory: the plugin files are missing; every guarded call is blocked\"}\n"; exit 0 ; }; d="${d%/*}"; done; exit 0'

sh -c 'f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/py/launch.sh"; [ -r "$f" ] && exec sh "$f" hook gate; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$d" in /*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; h="${HOME%/}"; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "$h" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do [ -f "$d/.factory/factory.toml" ] && { printf "vsdd-factory: the plugin files are missing, so the factory gates cannot run. Reinstall the plugin.\n" >&2; exit 2 ; }; d="${d%/*}"; done; exit 0'

sh -c 'f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/py/launch.sh"; [ -r "$f" ] && exec sh "$f" hook notify; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$d" in /*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; h="${HOME%/}"; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "$h" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do [ -f "$d/.factory/factory.toml" ] && { exit 0 ; }; d="${d%/*}"; done; exit 0'
